title: Staying Rooted in God's Unending Love
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals the transformative power of God's love and how it can overcome even the deepest hurts and wounds. As he delves into Ephesians 3:17, Pastor Chris shows us what it means to be rooted and grounded in love, and how this can give us a deeper understanding of God's incredible love for us. Don't miss this inspiring message that will challenge you to stay in love and experience the fullness of God's presence in your life.
